ref.substituent_description: Benzene with EtOOC at C1 and, para to it, CH=C(CH3)-. The methyl-bearing alkene carbon is bonded to C2 of 5,5,8,8-tetramethyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydronaphthalene, the aromatic carbon one CH away from a ring-fusion carbon. Each saturated carbon next to a fusion carbon carries two methyl stubs.
ref.notes: Typeset. 7 double bonds: 3 + 3 Kekule aromatic bonds and 1 C=C. All methyls are unlabelled line stubs. No E/Z label.

wrong.substituent_description: Benzene (circle) carrying an expanded ester (a C-shaped carbonyl carbon with =O above and OEt below) and, para to it, CH=C(CH3)-. The methyl-bearing alkene carbon is bonded to the aromatic carbon directly adjacent to a ring-fusion carbon (position 1, next to the gem-dimethyl carbon) of a tetramethyl-tetrahydronaphthalene whose aromatic ring is drawn with a circle.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The carbonyl carbon is drawn as a curled C-shaped stroke
The t of OEt looks like a plus sign
Several methyl stubs end in small hooks or arrow-like tips
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Double bonds: C=O (two parallel strokes) and the alkene C=C. Aromatic rings drawn as irregular circles.

correct.substituent_description: Benzene (circle) with EtOOC at C1 and, para to it, CH=C(CH3)-. The methyl-bearing alkene carbon is bonded to the tetralin aromatic carbon one CH away from a ring-fusion carbon (position 2), as in the reference. Two gem-dimethyl carbons sit next to the fusion carbons.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The first O of EtOOC is a tall oval resembling D
correct.notes: Handwritten, black ink. One drawn double bond (alkene); aromatic rings drawn with circles. No E/Z label, same as the reference.

errors_in_wrong.description: In the reference the alkene carbon is attached to C2 of the tetramethyltetralin (an aromatic carbon one CH away from the ring-fusion carbon). In the wrong drawing it is attached to the aromatic carbon directly adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon (C1, peri to a gem-dimethyl carbon).

The reference label EtOOC on the left benzene ring is expanded in the wrong drawing to a drawn carbonyl (C=O with the C written as a letter) plus an OEt label, so the reference abbreviation is not preserved.

review_notes: The wrong drawing has two problems: EtOOC is expanded to C(=O)OEt, and the vinyl group sits on the tetralin carbon next to the ring fusion instead of one carbon further along. The ring-position call comes from a freehand hexagon, but the edge from the attachment vertex to the fusion carbon looks clear. Please confirm which error was the intended one; it decides the primary category. The corrected drawing matches the reference; its O that looks like a D is only cosmetic.
